theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that is simultaneously eligible under the absolute-trend gate, shows the strongest durability (0.76), has the broadest leadership footprint (breadth 0.833), and is tagged as a trend. It is the headline one-narrative theme. The overweight is a direction, not a forecast: the tape is concentrating in a narrow eligible set and Banks is the only durable, broad, eligible name. Crowding (z=1.72) is treated strictly as a size-down caution, not as reason to fade.
evidence: eligible: true (only other eligible is Innovative Pharma & CXO)
breadth 0.833, the widest participation of any eligible theme
theses.dissent: Banks is already the crowded, dominant one-narrative theme; A-share financials often mean-revert on policy flows, and on this market's history the trend gate failed to reduce drawdown, so the eligible/durable signal has no validated forward edge.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks proxy) lags CSI 300 by 5% total return before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is the only other eligible theme (trend gate passes), meaning it has not broken its absolute trend. Its durability is moderate (0.60) and breadth is acceptable (0.571), though crowding (z=1.34) is elevated. The lean reflects that it is one of only two names the discipline permits at all, not a momentum or reversal view.
evidence: hurst_tag: mixed (weaker trend character than Banks)
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst tag and crowded positioning suggest the trend gate may be borderline; with only 2 eligible names the entire structure is fragile and the desk's own directional accuracy is low.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Innovative Pharma & CXO proxy) lags CSI 300 by 5% total return before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Robotics & Automation is rank 1 on raw momentum (score 0.75) but is NOT eligible under the absolute-trend gate and has a low durability_bar (0.38) with middling breadth (0.545). On this market the gate did not reduce drawdown historically, so ineligibility is not a predictive bear signal — it flags that the trend has not cleared the absolute bar. We avoid expressing a directional view on an unscorable, ineligible leader rather than treat the rank as a buy.
theses.dissent: Raw momentum leadership can persist in a narrative-focused tape even without gate eligibility; avoiding it may miss continuation, and the gate itself has no validated edge here.

falsifier.text: Robotics & Automation becomes eligible after a retrace and holds breadth above 0.55 for 15 consecutive trading days
